query: Which single-trial analysis approaches (e.g., LMM on trial amplitudes, time-resolved regressions) outperform averaged ERP windows for linking latent survey constructs to LPP dynamics?

response.query: Which single-trial analysis approaches (e.g., LMM on trial amplitudes, time-resolved regressions) outperform averaged ERP windows for linking latent survey constructs to LPP dynamics?
response.answer: Single-trial analysis approaches like LMM on trial amplitudes and time-resolved regressions outperform averaged ERP windows for linking latent survey constructs to LPP dynamics due to their ability to capture trial-by-trial variability. These methods provide more precise insights into individual differences.
